text:
alex: Quick async — we need a compact, machine-friendly error envelope for /v1/generate. Questions: 1) canonical HTTP status mapping, 2) a short error code field, 3) whether to include a retry hint and how streaming partials should end.

maria: +1 on standardizing. simple taxonomy proposal: 400 = syntactic/contract, 422 = semantic (prompt too long / banned content detected pre-run), 409 = idempotency/version conflict, 429 = rate limited, 502/503 = transient infra/model issues, 500 = unexpected non-retryable bugs.

sam: ops note — if transient, set retryable=true and prefer 503 or 502 over 500. clients should honor a `retry_after` seconds hint. SDKs should recommend exponential backoff + jitter.

dana: ops additions: include headers for routing/fallbacks: `X-Redwood-Fallback: model-small-v2` and `X-Trace-Id`. for capacity OOMs include `retry_after`. for streaming: if we detect a post-hoc validation (banned) after tokens emitted, finish partial stream then append an error envelope with `partial:true` and `retryable:false`.

alex: suggested minimal envelope (single object payload) that both humans and machines can parse: 
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "model_load_failed",
    "message": "failed to allocate kv cache",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 5,
    "details": "GPU0 OOM allocating kv cache",
    "trace_id": "rwd-abc-123"
  }
}
```

sam: minor question — if `retryable=true` should HTTP status still be 5xx? i think map retryable transient -> 503/502/504 as appropriate; keep 500 for internal bugs where retryable omitted or false.

maria: for 422 wording: make it clear clients can fix (e.g., shorten prompt, remove tags). 429 should include `quota_reset` or `retry_after`.

dana: +1, ops will only mark retryable=true for known transient classes; default is false. also log fallback via header so customers can see perf regressions.

alex: proposed client guidance to land in SDK readmes: retry only when `error.retryable===true` OR HTTP status in {502,503,504}, avoid retrying on 4xx except 409 when using idempotency strategy. i'll open a small PR with the envelope + mapping table. @sam please add SDK snippets referencing this. @dana we'll surface the headers and trace id.

maria: i'll review the PR and add wording for streaming bans.

sam: i'll update node/python SDK docs after merge.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch alex/error-envelope-compact — preflight running :rocket:

alex: thanks everyone, leaving this thread as the canonical decision. ping here for edge cases (partial stream bans, idempotency interactions).

-- end of thread --
